content.user_title: Review Code Changes with Structured Feedback
content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss important defects when the process is unclear. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through consistent reviews for local changes and pull requests.
actual_capabilities: Identify whether the review target is a remote pull request or local changes.
Guide use of git and GitHub CLI commands to inspect review context.
Recommend optional project preflight checks before deeper review.
Evaluate changes for correctness, maintainability, readability, efficiency, security, edge cases, and tests.
Structure review feedback into summary, findings, and a clear approval recommendation.
Prompt cleanup steps after remote pull request review.
limitations: It depends on the host agent having access to the repository and required CLI tools.
It does not guarantee that every bug or security issue will be found.
Preflight commands may vary by project and may need user confirmation.
Remote pull request review requires GitHub CLI access and repository permissions.

use_cases.title: Review a teammate pull request
use_cases.description: Check a remote PR for correctness, tests, maintainability, and security before approving it.

use_cases.title: Check local work before opening a PR
use_cases.description: Review staged and unstaged changes to catch problems before sharing them with the team.

use_cases.title: Standardize review feedback
use_cases.description: Use a consistent review structure for findings, improvements, nitpicks, and final recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Review my current changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my local changes and tell me if they are ready for a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Review a pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PR #123 for correctness, maintainability, security, and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on risky changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my staged changes and focus on correctness bugs, security issues, edge cases, and test gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Run a release-grade review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this PR as a release blocker review. Include critical findings, improvement suggestions, and an approve or request changes conclusion.

output_examples.input: Review my local changes before I open a PR.
output: Summary: The change is small and mostly safe, but one edge case needs attention.
Findings: A new null path can skip validation when the input list is empty.
Conclusion: Request changes until the edge case is covered by code and tests.

output_examples.input: Review PR #42 for maintainability and tests.
output: Summary: The implementation is readable and follows existing structure.
Improvements: Add a regression test for the error branch and simplify one duplicated condition.
Conclusion: Approve after the missing test is added.

output_examples.input: Check whether this security-sensitive change is ready.
output: Summary: The change needs more validation before merge.
Critical: User-controlled input reaches a database query without a clear allowlist.
Conclusion: Request changes and add tests for malicious input cases.

best_practices: Run or request the project verification suite when the change is substantial.
Provide review comments with clear reasons and concrete next steps.
Separate critical defects from improvement suggestions and optional nitpicks.
anti_patterns: Do not approve changes only because automated checks pass.
Do not leave vague feedback without explaining the risk or expected fix.
Do not switch branches or run optional commands without confirming user intent when needed.

faq.question: Can this skill review both local changes and pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports local staged or unstaged changes and remote pull requests by number or URL.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It recommends preflight checks and asks when optional project commands should be run.

faq.question: What does the review focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on correctness, maintainability, readability, efficiency, security, edge cases, error handling, and testability.

faq.question: Can it approve a pull request?
faq.answer: It can provide an approve or request changes recommendation based on the review findings.

faq.question: Does it replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure and improve review coverage, but human judgment remains important.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
